answer: Each agent identity must post a bond before it can earn or vote: a basalt foundation no swarm of forked processes can fake. Sybil resistance comes from pricing identity and linking behavior. Accounts sharing funding, timing, or mirrored outputs get clustered, and the whole cluster is slashed, so a fake bond becomes a worthless relic. Reaching the zenith of influence thus costs one full bond per fake identity plus a long unbonding delay, while that capital sits frozen. The attacker pays N bonds, forfeits them if caught, and splitting gains far less than it costs.
